facts.text: Snow left High Ridge (4,900 ft) 29 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: High Ridge
evidence.detail: left April 26; earlier seasons: May 27 (2023), May 25 (2024), May 25 (2025)

facts.text: At High Ridge (4,900 ft), this year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was 6.3 in, the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026).

evidence.name: High Ridge
evidence.detail: 6.3 in on April 2; earlier seasons: 37.4 in (2023), 23.0 in (2024), 31.7 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between March 3 and May 5, carried from the melt-out date at High Ridge (4,900 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: High Ridge
evidence.detail: melted out April 26, 1,291 ft above the pass; points to March 3 to May 5
